blocks.title: A pelican on a bike that only listens to your chat
blocks.description: Pelican Ride adds an animated scene to the activity panel. There are no buttons: ask the AI to change its speed, make it jump, ring the bell or switch the weather.

showcase.user_prompt: Make the pelican ride faster, jump three times, then switch to night.
showcase.assistant_reply: Speed is up from 3 to 5, the pelican is jumping three times, and the scene is fading into night. The Pelican Ride panel is open on the right.

items.title: Speed levels
items.description: Ride from a full stop to level 10. Ask for faster or slower and the AI adjusts from the current level.

items.title: Jumps and bell
items.description: Combine up to five jumps and five bell rings in a single request.

items.title: Four scenes
items.description: Switch between day, dusk, night and rain with a smooth transition.

items.title: Install and enable Pelican Ride
items.description: No account, key or extra software is required.

items.title: Start a conversation
items.description: Try a suggestion from the new conversation page, or describe what the pelican should do.

items.title: Watch the activity panel
items.description: Pelican Ride opens automatically when the AI changes the scene.

blocks.content: The game state lives only in the running app and resets when Vetta restarts or the plugin reloads. The bell plays a short sound.
